changed_family: candle provenance and auditability of the already-frozen swing, structure and BOS semantics
scope: terminal pending-BOS state at hard boundaries

candle_provenance.coverage_rule: real_minutes plus synthetic_minutes equals observed_minutes; observed_minutes cannot exceed expected_minutes
candle_provenance.complete_rule: a complete candle must have observed_minutes equal to expected_minutes
candle_provenance.real_completed_rule: complete is true and synthetic_minutes equals zero
candle_provenance.one_minute_mapping: a real source bar maps to real_minutes=1 and synthetic_minutes=0; a registered no-trade synthetic bar maps to real_minutes=0 and synthetic_minutes=1
candle_provenance.higher_timeframe_mapping: sum real_minutes and synthetic_minutes over the causally completed constituent 1m bars
candle_provenance.semantic_admission: only real_completed same-timeframe candles may enter ATR, pivot, confirmation, swing break, structure break, BOS attempt or BOS resolution logic
candle_provenance.clock_only_rule: a complete candle containing any synthetic minute advances the causal market clock but cannot change semantic state or semantic age

candidate_rule.high: the candidate high is strictly greater in integer ticks than both admitted real completed left bars
candidate_rule.low: the candidate low is strictly lower in integer ticks than both admitted real completed left bars

confirmation_rule.high: the following two admitted real completed same-timeframe candles must each have high strictly below the candidate high
confirmation_rule.low: the following two admitted real completed same-timeframe candles must each have low strictly above the candidate low
confirmation_rule.observed_at: end timestamp of the second admitted real completed right candle

relation_rule.price_comparison: round price to integer ticks before comparison
relation_rule.atr_use: description only; ATR cannot change the relation class

minimum_information: relation and prior same-side swing id
age in admitted real completed same-timeframe bars

structure.bull_forming: the latest confirmed relation contains HH or HL but the current latest high/low pair is not yet HH plus HL
structure.bull_confirmed: latest confirmed high relation is HH and latest confirmed low relation is HL
structure.bear_forming: the latest confirmed relation contains LH or LL but the current latest high/low pair is not yet LH plus LL
structure.bear_confirmed: latest confirmed high relation is LH and latest confirmed low relation is LL
structure.mixed_pair: HH plus LL or LH plus HL cannot confirm a new directional structure
structure.locking: once confirmed, one later LH in a bull structure or one later HL in a bear structure reduces run consistency but does not revert the structure to forming
structure.sequence_count: minimum of the current same-direction high-relation run and low-relation run
structure.bull_protected_swing: latest confirmed HL supporting the locked bull structure
structure.bear_protected_swing: latest confirmed LH supporting the locked bear structure
structure.protected_level_update: only a later causally confirmed supporting HL or LH may advance the protected level
structure.broken_rule: an admitted real completed candle of the same timeframe must close strictly through the frozen protected level in integer ticks

bos.pending_rule: an eligible already-confirmed structural swing creates a pending same-timeframe close-break candidate
bos.pending_at: target swing confirmed_at; historical candles are never replayed against a newly confirmed target
bos.up_confirmation: a later admitted real completed candle closes at an integer tick strictly above the confirmed structural swing high
bos.down_confirmation: a later admitted real completed candle closes at an integer tick strictly below the confirmed structural swing low
bos.wick_rule: wick-only penetration by an admitted real completed candle remains pending and is recorded separately as an attempt

failure_rules.superseded: a newer same-side confirmed structural target replaces the pending target
failure_rules.opposite_structure_break: an opposite BOS invalidates the source structure
failure_rules.data_gap_reset: at the first clock where an unknown gap is known, every pending BOS emits FAILED(data_gap_reset) before structure state is cleared
failure_rules.contract_change_reset: at the first clock where identity change is known, every pending BOS emits FAILED(contract_change_reset) before structure state is cleared

bos.minimum_delay: the target must be confirmed before the resolving candle ends; a target cannot be created and resolved from the same admitted candle

scope.continuation: BOS direction agrees with the locked confirmed structure
scope.opposed: BOS crosses the protected swing of the locked confirmed structure
scope.local: no locked confirmed structure existed at the break clock

clock_and_reset.scheduled_maintenance_or_weekend: preserve structure; age advances only on admitted real completed same-timeframe candles
clock_and_reset.registered_synthetic_market_time: advance the causal clock only; preserve ATR, pivots, structure, BOS and semantic ages
clock_and_reset.unknown_data_gap: terminalize pending BOS, then hard reset; no cross-gap relation or break
clock_and_reset.contract_change: terminalize pending BOS, then hard reset; no cross-contract price relation or break
clock_and_reset.simultaneous_gap_and_contract_change: emit one contract_change_reset terminal state, preserve both reader anomaly codes in event metadata, and advance reset_epoch once
clock_and_reset.cross_timeframe_confirmation: forbidden; 1m close cannot confirm 5m, 1H or 4H BOS

playbook_interfaces.inheritance: identical to configs/smc_primitives_v3_0_structure_bos.json; no playbook formula or gate changes are authorized by this patch

displacement_first_pullback.context: 4H locked confirmed HH/HL or LH/LL structure with an explicit directional draw
displacement_first_pullback.hard_gate: a later 1H same-direction continuation BOS is required

liquidity_sweep_reversal.contradiction: continuation BOS in the sweep direction

failed_auction_value_return.hard_gate: BOS cannot replace the not-yet-implemented mature accumulation, range value and re-entry primitives
